title: Attach realtime evidence without blocking participant flow

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Realtime diagnostic evidence tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/diagnostics/test_realtime_evidence.py tests/promo/test_realtime_attempt_integration.py

verify.summary: Fresh independent T2 verification passed FT-007-AC-002/003, the disposable result/zero-proposal/busy/deadline/technical-failure and writer-isolation matrix, response/display finalization, no-selfie/protected-data scope, owner-boundary review, required mypy and Memory Bank lint gates, and cleanup. Task remains in_progress; no lifecycle transition was performed.

Scheduler closed TASK-085 after the same Attempt 1 executor READY_FOR_VERIFY handoff, the single Judge-authorized post-implementation backend build with current-tree/image SHA match, literal pytest/mypy/lint gates, and fresh independent Verify PASS. No T2 red-verify is required.

evidence_required: FT-007-AC-002 RED: the current realtime path produces search observations and Promo truth but has no diagnostics provider call, persisted reproducibility bundle or explicit complete/partial/absent projection; GREEN: promo calls diagnostics best-effort for result, zero-proposal, busy, deadline and technical-failure paths, preserving applicable release/pipeline/values, selected and repeated detections, candidate pools, teasers, complete union/N, camera/config, response and display/QR events, while forced provider/finalization failure leaves the identical participant outcome and an explicit incomplete gap; decisive comparison: same disposable Attempt/session response and owner rows with healthy, partial, absent and failing writers; artifact: focused realtime/evidence integration under .tasks/TASK-085-T2-FT-007-W3/.

FT-007-AC-003 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: the accepted claim makes capture-media persistence optional and the current pilot captures no selfie, so manufacturing missing media storage as RED would falsify scope; alternative proof: representative evidence/auth inventory and source/runtime scans show that image content alone creates no developer-only rule, no capture object/cache/per-crop log/selfie is required or created, and any existing non-media protected fields retain their separate boundary; artifact: bundle inventory and scope scan under .tasks/TASK-085-T2-FT-007-W3/.
purpose: Complete the promo consumer integration that records reproducible diagnostics-owned search/result evidence while proving evidence collection cannot affect the participant outcome.
success_outcome: Every exercised admitted path retains the same core participant truth with complete evidence when all applicable events arrive or an explicit partial/absent gap when they do not, without requiring capture-media or selfie persistence.
anti_goals: Do not change search selection, thresholds, teaser assembly, N, result/session publication or display semantics.
Do not add Attempts UI, structured-log search, annotations, Calibration or an automatic replay runner.
Do not introduce mandatory capture-media storage, per-crop logs, embeddings, a reliable evidence outbox or cross-owner writes.

forbidden_scope: Production Attempts/media/credentials and operator/default diagnostic records
Processing selection/search algorithms, Promo result/session/display truth and serving settings
FT-008 investigation UI, FT-009 log records, FT-010 annotations and FT-011 Calibration
stop_conditions: Evidence attachment cannot remain a best-effort promo-to-diagnostics application call.
Failure isolation would require rollback/retry of a valid core Attempt or participant result.
Required evidence would force embeddings, credentials, personalized session payloads, mandatory media or a selfie record.
Stateful integration cannot be exercised with disposable owner-scoped rows and safe cleanup.

constraints: Primary evidence owner is diagnostics; promo passes immutable core/search/result/display observations only through the accepted application boundary and never writes the evidence table directly.
Reuse completed processing observation and promo result types; do not widen provider ownership or duplicate search/result decisions in an HTTP handler.

Treat writer absence, partial write, validation failure and finalization failure as non-throwing diagnostic outcomes with explicit gaps; rely on the TASK-084 provider boundary for its separately owned privacy validation.
Use unique disposable Attempts/sessions/evidence rows with controlled clocks and writer failure injection, observable owner state, safe rerun and cleanup limited to fixtures.
invariants: Core Attempt, result/session and display truth are identical with a healthy, absent or failing evidence writer.
A complete bundle contains only applicable actual observations; missing detail remains incomplete and is never fabricated.
Diagnostics owns evidence writes and promo owns core/result writes; neither bypasses the accepted edge.
No mandatory capture media, selfie, embeddings, credentials, authentication state, commercial original or personalized session data enters evidence.
verification_targets: Result, zero-proposal, busy, deadline and technical-failure integrations compare core/result/session state and participant response across healthy, partial, absent and failing diagnostics writers while inspecting exact bundle/gap content.
Candidate fixtures reconcile selected/repeated detections, matches, teaser IDs and complete union/N to the existing processing/promo outputs without adopting their dependency claims.

Data-policy inventory proves no required capture object/cache/per-crop log/selfie and excludes embeddings, credentials, auth/session payloads, commercial originals and request bodies without re-owning TASK-084's provider privacy claim.
